 end
end

local lib=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("MareAssets") assert(lib,"NO_LIB")
local old=workspace:FindFirstChild("PalaceKitGallery") if old then old:Destroy() end
local g=Instance.new("Folder") g.Name="PalaceKitGallery" g.Parent=workspace
local out={} local x=-900
for i,k in {{"Town","eastasia-base"},{"Town","eastasia-bell"},{"Town","eastasia-column-base"},{"Town","eastasia-roof"},{"Town","eastasia-stairs"},{"Town","temple-stone"},{"Town","temple-tower"},{"Castle","fortress"},{"Castle","tower-square-base"},{"Castle","tower-square-mid-windows"},{"Castle","tower-square-top-roof"},{"Castle","wall"},{"Castle","gate"},{"Terrain","egypt-temple-wall"},{"Terrain","egypt-temple-arch-a"},{"Terrain","egypt-temple-door"},{"Terrain","egypt-column"},{"Terrain","mystic-stone-arch"},{"Terrain","ruins-wall-arched"},{"Naval","tower-complete-large"},{"Naval","tower-roof"},{"Terrain","gate-overhang"}} do
 local grp=lib:FindFirstChild(k[1]) local t=grp and grp:FindFirstChild(k[2])
 if t and t:IsA("Model") then
  local m=t:Clone() local _,sz=m:GetBoundingBox() local s=18/math.max(sz.X,sz.Y,sz.Z) m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale()*s)
  local cf,sz2=m:GetBoundingBox() m:PivotTo(m:GetPivot()+(Vector3.new(x,sz2.Y/2,-700)-cf.Position)) m.Parent=g
  table.insert(out,string.format("%s=%.1fx%.1fx%.1f",k[2],sz.X,sz.Y,sz.Z)) x+=26
 else table.insert(out,k[2].."=MISSING") end
end
workspace:SetAttribute("ShotFov",50) workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF",CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-900+13*26,60,-600),Vector3.new(-900+13*26,6,-700),Vector3.new(0,1,0)))
return "KIT_SIZES "..table.concat(out," ")
